summary: The code is syntactically correct and includes a fairly complete agent-based simulation framework with social influence, policy, media, mobility, and market modules. However, it does not fully implement the required task: main() is empty (the simulation never runs), several required evaluation metrics are missing or misnamed, some specified parameters/behaviors are not implemented (e.g., enforcement_probability, campaign_frequency_days, restock_period_days, supply_delay_days), and adoption inequality is computed by SES rather than income quantiles. There are minor logic and performance issues as well.

issues.description: main() is empty, so the simulation is never executed even though it is called at the end of the file.
issues.location: main() at the top and final call at the bottom
issues.solution: Implement main() to instantiate Simulation(MODEL_PLAN) or a plan consistent with the provided task spec, call run(), and optionally evaluate() and print/save metrics.

issues.description: Required evaluation metrics from the task spec are missing or not exposed: policy_compliance_rate, mask_availability, price_level, adoption_inequality_by_income. Current evaluate() only returns adoption_rate_over_time, time_to_threshold, and a custom set of summary metrics.
issues.solution: Add metrics: (1) policy_compliance_rate: share of visits to mask-required locations where individuals are compliant (weighted by attendees). (2) mask_availability: average retailer inventory and frequency of stockouts per day. (3) price_level: average mask price across retailers over time; expose time series. (4) adoption_inequality_by_income: compute difference in adoption between top and bottom income quantiles (e.g., top 20% vs bottom 20%). Expose these in evaluate() under the spec names.

issues.description: Parameter names and behaviors from the spec are not fully supported or normalized. Examples: enforcement_probability, campaign_frequency_days, location_mask_requirement_default, location_enforcement_level_default, restock_period_days, supply_delay_days, purchase_threshold_price_sensitivity.
issues.location: Parameter normalization in Simulation._normalize_params() and usage across modules
issues.solution: Normalize and use the spec parameters: implement enforcement_probability as a probability applied to enforcement actions; support campaign_frequency_days for periodic media boosts; use location defaults from spec; implement retailer restock_period_days and supply_delay_days; incorporate purchase_threshold_price_sensitivity in BehaviorDecisionModule purchasing logic.

issues.description: Mandate activation requires both mandate_start_day and mandate_end_day to be non-None; this prevents using a start-only mandate or the spec's mandate_active_initial.
issues.solution: Support mandate_active_initial and allow mandates with only a start day (active from start forward until end or end of horizon). Consider also a toggle based on Government behavior.

issues.description: Adoption inequality is computed by SES quintiles rather than by income quantiles as required.
issues.solution: Compute top and bottom income quantiles (e.g., 20th and 80th percentiles) and measure the difference in adoption rates; expose as adoption_inequality_by_income.

issues.description: policy_compliance_rate is not computed according to spec. Current location_compliance_rate averages all locations regardless of policy; spec wants share of visits to mandate-required locations where individuals are compliant.
issues.solution: When computing compliance, restrict to locations where mask_policy == 'required' and weight by number of attendees or visits.

issues.description: Person.daily_contacts is never updated although defined in the Person dataclass.
issues.solution: Update each person's daily_contacts counter using contacts_per_agent to reflect actual contact counts.

issues.description: Free mask distribution performs O(n) agent lookup per recipient using next(...) on the agents list.
issues.solution: Use an id_to_agent dictionary (already used in other modules) for O(1) lookup.

issues.description: Mismatch between metric naming and spec: time_to_50pct_adoption vs time_to_50_percent_adoption; mask_availability vs daily_supply_fraction; price_level vs avg_price.
issues.solution: Align metric keys to the spec names or provide both names for compatibility.

issues.description: Risk signal and authority trust weights from the spec (social_influence_weight, authority_trust_weight, risk_signal_level, decision_noise) are not directly mapped to the internal variables used in decision-making.
issues.solution: Normalize spec weights to internal weights: map social_influence_weight to peer_influence_weight, authority_trust_weight to trust_weight, risk_signal_level to a global risk modifier, and decision_noise to adoption_noise.
